scope: Actual final browser screenshots inspected; qualitative map-surface review, not comparison with surveyed terrain or site photographs.

images.observation: Huangpu River edge and north-side Suzhou Creek are visible beside the district ground proxy; district boundary clips the water footprint.
Dianshan Lake, surrounding islands and the mapped channel network remain visible; controls no longer cover the model.
Chongming and surrounding island land are separated from the estuary water; outer straight edges are administrative clipping boundaries, not riverbanks.
All district surfaces render together; distant exclaves broaden the fitted extent and make central Shanghai smaller.
Complete district mesh remains visible above the controls at 390x844; no horizontal overflow.
